headline: On last trading day, Sensex rose 300 points, recovering slightly from Thursday's sharp 1,200-point market crash.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 29 September.

why: Auto and consumer durables sectors gained nearly 1% during the last trading session
A recovery attempt followed Thursday's massive crash where the Sensex plummeted over 1,200 points
Global yields, rising oil prices, and capital outflows led to a seventh straight weekly decline
The Nifty 50 managed to settle near 23,150 after falling below 23,100 earlier in the week
whatHappening: Vedanta is pitching a ₹1 lakh crore investment in Odisha to revive Niyamgiri mining operations
Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman stated that India has not missed the global artificial intelligence development bus
The Election Commission extended the deadline for Special Institutional Reform orders in Delhi and Maharashtra
Truck manufacturers are expanding their reach as freight demand spreads beyond major Indian cities
summary: The Indian market ended its last session on Friday with a 300-point gain, partially recovering from a sharp 1,200-point crash on Thursday. Despite the daily bounce, indices recorded their seventh consecutive weekly loss due to global headwinds and sustained capital outflows. Vedanta emerged as a key focus after proposing a ₹1 trillion investment plan for mining and industrial growth in Odisha.
